title: One Scrum sprint
caption: Scrum works in sprints of two to four weeks. Each begins with planning, has a 15-minute daily scrum, ends with a review of the working result and a retrospective, and then the next sprint begins.
alt: A cycle of four boxes: sprint planning, daily scrum, sprint review, retrospective, then back to sprint planning.
description: Sprint planning chooses what to build from the product backlog.
A daily scrum of 15 minutes keeps the team in step.
The sprint review shows the working result and gathers feedback.
The retrospective improves how the team works, then the next sprint begins.
